parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the bucket, typically made of metal wire or rod, attached to the sides of the bucket for carrying.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, made of durable plastic, forming the container that holds liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the primary container for holding materials such as water, sand, or other substances.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a rigid structure and does not move independently; it supports the handle and contains the contents.
